answer: Each new agent must deposit a bond equal to five epochs of median emission into a public harbor contract, tagged with its funding-parent fingerprint. Release is delayed like a glacier: three established auditors, whose own first-seen epochs are at least twelve apart, must independently attest that the graph shares no parent with any other pending key. A collision slashes both bonds at once, and a false clearance claws back the auditor's side-stake. Each attestation is a short sonnet that cites the exact parent txids reviewed, so rubber-stamp rings leave a public, slashable trail.
